snippet.title: TERRIBLE LIFE EXPECTANCY Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Teaser Trailer of our next game Terrible Life Expectancy, out Q4 2025.
This is a roguelite horror top down shooter where as a family of Teeth Reapers, you fight hordes of mutated humans in the streets of a Japanese town using your weapons arsenal and inherited upgraded gear until the origin of all this death is destroyed forever.

Wishlist now on Steam! https://t.co/MsF3JiJtbB
